items.name: White Mesa Mill Phase Two circuit expansion (Bankable Feasibility Study)
items.claim: Energy Fuels released results of a Bankable Feasibility Study for a planned rare earth element circuit expansion at its White Mesa Mill, targeting a planned 6,000 tpa NdPr, 240 tpa Dysprosium, and 66 tpa Terbium capability.
items.source_excerpt: Planned 6,000 tpa NdPr, 240 tpa Dysprosium, and 66 tpa Terbium Capability with First Quartile Cost Position

items.name: White Mesa Mill heavy rare earth (Tb/Dy/Sm/Eu/Gd) plant construction
items.claim: Energy Fuels began construction on a White Mesa Mill expansion designed to add capacity to produce up to approximately 20 tpa of terbium, 120 tpa of dysprosium, 140 tpa of samarium, 20 tpa of europium, and 140 tpa of gadolinium oxides, with the Tb and Dy circuits expected complete by the end of 2027 and the Sm, Eu and Gd circuits by the end of 2028.
items.source_excerpt: The planned expansion is designed to add the capacity to produce up to approximately 20 tpa of terbium (Tb), 120 tpa of dysprosium (Dy), 140 tpa of samarium (Sm), 20 tpa of europium (Eu), and 140 tpa of gadolinium (Gd) oxides, along with other rare earth elements 2 : Tb and Dy are heavy rare earths added to most high-end rare earth permanent magnets (REPMs) to increase resistance to demagnetization (coercivity) and high-temperature performance, and to enable smaller, lighter, more powerful, and more efficient electric motors. The planned expansion is expected to be completed by the end of 2027, with respect to the addition of the Tb and Dy circuits and by the end of 2028 with respect to the addition of the Sm, Eu and Gd circuits.
